senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Who or what passes over or beyond.
m. (-रः)
1 Passing over, crossing.
2 A float, a raft.
3 A road.
4 A tree.
f. (री)
1 A boat.
2 A club.
3 A clothes basket, a Pitāra.
4 Smoke.
5 A small wooden baling vessel.
6 The end of a garment.
E.
तॄ to cross, affix अप्, fem. affix ङीष्; also with इन् affix तरि, q. v.

mfn. adj. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 High, as a note in music.
2 Radiant, shining, radiating.
3 Clean, clear.
4 Good, excellent, well flavoured, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A high note or tone in music.
2 Elegance of a pearl.
3 A clear or beautiful pearl.
4 Crossing, passing over, &c.
5 A wire, a chord.
6 The mystic monosyllable Om.
7 A mystical monosyllable in the Tantras.
8 The name of a monkey chief, the son of BĀLĪ.
n. (-रं)
1 Silver.
2 A pearl.
mfn. subst. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 The pupil of the eye.
2 A star in general, a planet, an asterism, &c.
f. (-रा)
A female deity peculiar to the Bauddha sect.
2 The wife of VṚHASPATI.
3 The wife of the monkey king SUGRĪVA.
4 A name of the goddess DURGĀ.
E.
तॄ to pass or proceed; also in the causal, to cause to pass, and अच् or घञ् aff.

m. (-क्षुः)
A hyena.
E.
तर a road, and क्षि to annoy^1, affix डु infesting the road; also with कन् added तरक्षुक. m. (-कः) or with ड affix तरक्ष. m. (-क्षः) but not common.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A wave.
2 Cloth or clothes.
3 The gallop of a horse.
E.
तॄ to pass over or cross, Uṇādi affix अङ्गच्.

f. (-णी)
A river.
E.
तरङ्ग a wave, इनि and ङीष् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wavy, billowy, tossing with waves.
E.
तरङ्ग, and इतच् aff.

m. (-णः)
1 A raft, a float.
2 Svarga or paradise.
n. (-णं)
1 Crossing over, passing, going across.
2 Removing from an inundation.
E.
तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Who or what causes or enables to cross.
m. (-णः)
A raft, a float.
n. (-णं)
Carrying or conveying across.
E.
तॄ to cross, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-णिः)
1 The sun.
2 A ray of light.
3 A float or raft.
f. (-णिः or णी)
1 A boat. The Socotrine aloe, (A. perfoliata.)
3 A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
तॄ to cross, Uṇādi affix अनि.

f. (-णिः)
A boat.
E.
तॄ to pass over, अनि aff.

m. (-कः)
An oval bowl or bason of wood, for baling a boat.
E.
तरणि, and पेटक a basket, the boat's basket.

n. (-त्नं)
A ruby.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा or ण्डी-ण्डं)
A boat, a vessel.
mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 A raft or float, made of bambus, &c. tied together, and sometimes floated upon jars or hollow gourds inverted.
2 The float of a fishing line.
3 An oar.
m. (-ण्डः)
A country.
E.
तॄ to cross, अण्डन् aff.

f. (-दा)
A boat.
E.
तरण्ड an oar, and पाद a foot, having oars for feet.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Crossing, passing over.
n. (-रत् or रद्)
1 A float or raft.
2 A kind of duck.
E.
तॄ to cross, शतृ affix of the active participle.

m. (-लः)
Conflagration of chaff: see तृणाग्नि.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A fog.
2 A hard shower, a torrent of rain.
3 The ocean.
f. (-न्ती)
A boat.
E.
तॄ to cross, झच् aff.

n. (-जं)
A watermelon, (most probably borrowed from the Persian, تربز)

n. (-ण्यं)
Fare, freight.
E.
तर passing (a river), and पण्य price.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Trembling, tremulous.
2 Libidinous, lecherous, wanton.
3 Luminous, splendid.
4 Hollow.
5 Liquid, liquefied.
m. (-लः)
1 The central gem of a necklace.
2 A necklace.
3 Bottom, depth, lower or under part.
f. (-ला)
1 Rice gruel.
2 Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor.
3 A bee.
E.
तॄ to pass, to go or move, affix कल.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Libidinous, dissipated, a lecher.
E.
तरल unsteady, affix अण्.

f. (-ता)
Tremulousness, unsteadiness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, तललत्वं.

f. (-ना)
A woman with rolling or tremulous eyes.
E.
तरल trembling, and लोचना an eye.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Caused to tremble, agitated, undulating.
m. (-तः)
1 A large wave or surf.
2 Fickleness.
E.
तरल used as a verb, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, trembling, tremulous.
E.
तरल trembling, and इतच् aff.

m. (-रिः)
A sword, a scymitar.
E.
तर passing, वॄ to effect, इञ् affix; making its pass through the enemy, &c. also तरवारिक m. (-कः.)

n. (-रः)
1 Speed, velocity.
2 Strength.
3 A bank.
4 A float, a raft.
E.
तॄ to go, to go quick, &c. असुन् aff.

n. (-सं)
Flesh.
E.
तरस् strength, affix अच्; in which there is strength.

n. (-नं)
A landing place, a wharf or stairs.
E.
तर passing, ferrying, and स्थान place.

mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्)
1 Quick, swift.
2 Valiant.
E.
तरस्, and वतुप् aff.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
1 Quick, swift.
2 Strong, valiant.
m. (-स्वी)
1 A courier, an express, a runner.
2 A hero.
3 The bird of VIṢṆU.
4 Air, wind.
E.
तरस् speed, &c. विनि aff.

m. (-न्धुः)
A large flat bottomed boat.
E.
तर crossing, अन्धु water; perhaps a various reading of the next.

m. (-लुः)
A flat bottomed boat.
E.
तर passing over, आलुच् affix: see the preceding.

f. (-रिः)
1 A boat.
2 A clothes basket.
3 The end of a cloth.
E.
तॄ to pass, Uṇādi affix इन्; also with ङीष् affix तरी see तर, &c.

n. (-कं)
A raft, a float.
m. (-कः)
A ferry-man.
f. (-का)
A boat.
E.
तरि a boat, कन् aff.

n. (-कं)
Fare, freight, toll.
f. (-का)
1 A star; also तारका.
2 The juice of the palmyra tree, especially when become a spirit by spontaneous fermentation.
E.
तर fare, ठक् affix, or तारक fem. form, or ताल and कन् added, ल changed to र.

m. (-की)
A ferry-man.
E.
तरिक a raft, इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Carried over or across.
f. (-ता)
1 The fore finger.
2 Garlic, or perhaps hemp: see गृञ्जन.
E.
त to cross, इनि aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-णि)
Who or what crosses.
f. (-णी)
A boat.
E.
तृ to go, in the causal, affix क्त.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Enabling or causing to cross or get over.
f. (-णी)
1 A goddess peculiar to the Jainas or Bauddhas.
2 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
तॄ to cause to proceed, (life, fortune, &c.) and ङीष् aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
What crosses, passes or carries over.
f. (-त्री)
A boat, a raft.
E.
तृ to cross, तृच् aff.

m. (-थः)
An oar, a paddle.
E.
तरि a boat, and रथ a car.

m. (-षः)
1 The ocean.
2 Heaven or paradise.
3 Decorating, ornamenting.
4 A raft, a float.
5 Practice, business, profession.
f. (-षी)
1 The daughter of INDRA.
E.
तॄ to cross or cause to cross, Uṇādi affix ईषन्; in some of its senses this word and तबिष seem to be confounded: see तबिष and ताविष.

m. (-षः)
1 Svarga or paradise.
2 The ocean.
3 Gold.
f. (-षी)
The daughter of INDRA.
E.
तृ to cross, ईषन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see तरीष and तविष.

m. (-रुः)
A tree.
E.
तॄ to proceed, Uṇādi affix उ; what goes or grows; or from what flowers and fruits arise, &c.

m. (-णिः)
A sort of bird.
E.
तरु a tree, and कूण to contract, affix कि; nestling in the tree.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Borne, produced by a tree, (as a flower, fruit, &c.)
E.
तरु, and ज born.

n. (-नं)
The root of a tree.
E.
तरु a tree, and जीवन living.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Young, juvenile.
2 New, fresh, novel.
m. (-णः)
1 A young man, one of the virile age.
2 The castor oil plant.
3 Large cumin seed.
f. (-णी)
1 A young woman from 16 to 30 years of age; generally however one about the first age.
2 The aloe tree, (A. perfoliata.)
3 A perfume, commonly Chira.
4 A flower, the Indian white rose, (Rosa standulifera.)
n. (-णं)
A kind of flower, that of the Achyranthes aspera? (कुजपुष्प.)
E.
तॄ to pass away, उनन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
A fever that lasts a week.
E.
तरुण, and ज्वर fever.

n. (-धि)
Curds five days old.
E.
तरुण, and दधि curds.

n. (-स्थि)
Cartilage, gristle.
E.
तरुण, and अस्थि bone.

m. (-णः)
A number of young women.
E.
तरुणी, and गण a troop.

m. (-नः)
A young woman.
E.
तरुणी, and जन person.

m. (-लः)
The part under the branches of a tree, the ground about its root.
E.
तरु, and तल below.

f. (-का)
The flying fox.
E.
तरु a tree, and तूलिका scales, suspended like a balance from the branches of a tree; also read तरुदूलिका.

m. (-खः)
A thorn.
E.
तरु a tree, and नख a nail.

तरुपङ्क्ति^1
f. (-क्तिः)
A row of trees, an avenue.
E.
तरु, and पंक्ति a line.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Dhaval Patel on 20151215. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/171. note: Convention error..

m. (-क्)
A parasite plant.
E.
तरु, and भुज what enjoys.

m. (-गः)
A monkey, an ape.
E.
तरु a tree, and मृग a deer.

m. (-गः)
1 A bud, a blossom.
2 A new sprout.
E.
तरु a tree, राग delight.

m. (-पः)
A branch or sprout.
E.
तरु, and विटप a shoot.

m. (-जः)
The palmyra tree.
E.
तरु, and राज king, chief.

f. (-हा)
A parasite plant.
E.
तरु, and रुह what mounts.

f. (-णी)
A parasite plant.
E.
तरु, and रोहिणी what ascends.

m. (-यी)
A bird.
E.
तरु a tree, and शीङ्^1 to sleep, with णिनि aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-रः)
Camphor.
E.
तरु a tree, and सार essence.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Staying or being in a tree.
f. (-स्था)
A parasite plant.
E.
तरु, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-टः)
The root of the lotus.

r. 10th cl. (तर्कयति)
1 To shine.
2 To speak.
3 To reason, to discuss.
4 To doubt or apprehend.

m. (-र्कः)
1 Doubt or disputation, discussion, reasoning.
2 Wish, desire.
3 Supplying an ellipsis.
4 Cause, motive.
5 The science of reasoning, logic.
6 (In Logic,) Reduction to absurdity, a conclusion opposed to or disproving the premises.
E.
तर्क to infer, to reason, &c. affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A supplicant, a petitioner, an asker.
2 A logician.
E.
तर्क to reason, and affix वुन्.

mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Expecting, anticipating.
2 Doubting.
E.
तर्क to doubt, शतृ aff.

f. (-द्या)
The science of reasoning or logic.
E.
तर्क as above, and विद्या knowledge.

m. (-सः)
Apparent reduction to absurdity, or seeming not real, incompatibility of the conclusion with the premises.
E.
तर्क, and आभास fallacy.

f. (-री)
A tree, (Aeschynomene sesban.)
E.
तर्क reasoning, ऋ to go or affect, affixes अण and ङीप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Doubted, apprehended.
2 Discussed.
E.
तर्क to doubt, क्त aff.

m. (-की)
A logician, a disputant, a follower of the Tarka Śāstra.
E.
तर्क as above, इनि aff.

m. (-लः)
Cassia tora.

f. (-र्कुः)
A spindle, an iron pin upon which the cotton is first drawn out; it also serves as the distaff, the cotton being next transferred from it to the wheel.
E.
कृत to cut, Uṇādi affix उ, and the radical letters transposed.

n. (-टं)
Drawing out the cotton upon the distaff or upon the wheel.
f. (-टी)
A spindle or a distaff: see तर्कु.
E.
कृत to cut, &c. उटच् affix, and the radical letters transposed.

m. (-ण्डः)
A ball of clay, &c. upon the lower end of the spindle to assist in giving it a rotatory motion.
E.
तर्कु as above, पिण्ड a lump.

f. (-ठी)
A ball at the lower end of a spindle: see the preceding.
E.
तर्कु a spindle, and पीठ a stool.

m. (-कः)
A concave shell or saucer in which the lower end of the spindle is placed, and whirled round.
E.
तर्कु a spindle, लस to go, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-णः)
A small whetstone, for sharpening spindles, &c.
E.
तर्कु a spindle, and शाण a whetstone.

m. (-र्क्षुः)
A hyena.
E.
तर्ज to give pain, affix कु; also तरक्षु.

m. (-र्क्ष्यः)
Nitre, saltpetre.

m. (-र्क्ष्यः)
1 A horse.
2 A name of GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
3 A name of ARUṆA, or the dawn personified, considered as the elder brother of GARUḌA.
4 A car, a chariot.
5 A snake.
6 Gold.
7 A tree, the Sal, (Shorea robusta.)
n. (-र्क्ष्यं)
A sort of collyrium.
f. (-र्क्ष्यी)
A wild creeper.
E.
तृक्ष to go, घञ् affix तार्क्ष and यत् added; again, तृक्ष or तार्क्षं considered as a name of KAŚYAPA the father of ARUṆA, &c. ष्यञ् or अण् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (तर्जति-ते तर्जयति)
To blame, to censure, to reprove.

n. (-नं)
1 Blaming, censuring.
2 Pointing at, in ridicule, or contempt.
3 Putting to shame, surpassing.
4 Wrath, anger.
f. (-नी)
The forefinger.
E.
तर्ज to abuse, to injure, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.

m. (-कः)
The name of a country, perhaps to the north-west of India or Bokhara, &c. the country of the Tājiks: also तायिक.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blamed, reviled.
2 Shamed, disgraced.
E.
तर्ज to blame, affix क्त.

m. (-र्णः)
A calf.
E.
तॄ to go, ण affix; also with कन् added, तर्णक.

m. (-कः)
A calf: see the preceding.

m. (-र्णिः)
1 A raft, a float.
2 The sun.
E.
तॄ to cross, affix णि.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A passenger, one who passes or crosses.
n. (-कं)
A boat, a raft, a vessel.
E.
तॄ to cross over, ईकन् aff. and deriv. irr.

r. 1st cl. (तर्दति)
To kill or hurt.

m. (-र्दूः)
A wooden ladle.
E.
तॄ to go, Uṇādi affix उ, and दूट् augment.

n. (-णं)
1 Satisfaction given or received; either the act of pleasing, or the state of being pleased.
2 Satiety, fulness.
3 A religious rite, presenting water to the manes of the deceased or to the Pitṛs collectively; also to the gods either generally or individually.
4 Fuel used on sacrificial occasions. []
f. (-णी)
A plant; also गुरुस्कन्ध.
E.
तृप to satisfy or be satisfied, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-च्छुः-च्छुः-च्छु)
Desirous of satisfaction, or of receiving after death the presentation of water called Tarpaṇa.
m. (-च्छुः)
A name of BHĪṢMA.
E.
तर्पण as above, इच्छु to wish, and उ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pleased, satisfied.
E.
तृप to be pleased, क्त affix, with इट्.

mfn. (-र्पी-र्पिणी-र्पि)
1 Giving pleasure or satisfaction.
2 Offering oblations to the manes, (who does so.)
f. (-णी)
A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
तृप to give pleasure, इनि and ङीप् affs.

r. 1st cl. (तर्बति)
To go or move.

m. (-टः)
A year.
E.
तर्ब्ब^1 to go, अटन् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by SergeA on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batche 313.

n. (-र्म्म)
The top or term of the sacrificial post.
E.
तॄ to pass up, and मनिन् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Thirst.
2 Wish, desire.
3 The ocean.
4 A raft or float.
5 The sun.
E.
तृष to thirst, affix अच्, or तॄ to pass over, and ष Uṇādi aff.

n. (-णं)
Thirst, thirsting: it is also used metaphorically.
E.
तृष to thirst, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thirsting, athirst, thirsty.
2 Desiring, wishing for.
E.
तृष to thirst, affix क्त.

ind.
Therefore.
E.
तद that, and र्हिल् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A protector, a preserver.
2 One who causes or enables to pass or go over.
n. (-कं)
1 The eye.
2 A Mantra, a formula addressed to Rāma, as Rāmāya namaḥ,
nf. (-कं-का)
1 The pupil of the eye.
2 A star.
mn. (-कः-कं)
A float or raft.
m. (-कः)
A pilot, a helmsman or steersman.
2 The name of a demon or evil spirit destroyed by KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
तॄ to pass or cause to pass, and ण्वुल् affix; or कन added to the preceding.

m. (-जित्)
A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
तारक a demon, and जित् conqueror: also similar names, as तारकारि, तारकहन्, तारकरिपु, &c.

m. (-रिः)
The deity KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
तारक, and अरि a foe: see the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Starry.
E.
तारक a star, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-की-किणी-कि)
Starry.
f. (-णी)
Night.
E.
तारक, and इनि aff.

n. (-म्यं)
1 More or less, the state or condition.
2 Dependance of larger numbers on smaller in a progressive series.
E.
तर, and तम affixes of the comparative and superlative degrees, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-दः)
A loud sound or noise.
E.
तार, and नाद sound.

f. (-ला)
A sort of mineral said to be of the colour of silver.
E.
तार a star, and विमल pure, clean.

n. (-रं)
Lead.
E.
तार silver, शुद्धिकर what refines.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
तारा a star, and अधिपति a ruler.

m. (-थः)
The atmosphere, the firmament, heaven or sky.
E.
तारा a star, and पथ for पथिन् a path.

m. (-डः)
The moon.
E.
तार a star, and आपीड a chaplet.

f. (-षा)
Night.
E.
तारा, and भूषा ornament.

m. (-भ्रः)
Camphor.
E.
तारा, and अभ्र talc.

m. (-लः)
1 A large splendid temple.
2 The region of the stars.
E.
तारा a star, and मण्डल a region; shining with gold and jewels as with stars.

m. (-रिः)
A pyritic ore of iron: see विट्माक्षिक.
E.
तारा the pupil of the eye, and अरि hostile.
